link_text: CODE OF ORDINANCES TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW, OKLAHOMA
Chapter 22 - LICENSES, TAXATION AND MISCELLANEOUS BUSINESS REGULATIONS
Chapter 30 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

Ordinance No. 2026-6.1 Adopted 6/8/26 AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING AND ENACTING A NEW CODE FOR THE TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW, OKLAHOMA; PROVIDING FOR THE REPEAL OF CERTAIN ORDINANCES NOT INCLUDED THEREIN; PROVIDING A PENALTY FOR THE VIOLATION THEREOF; PROVIDING FOR THE MANNER OF AMENDING SUCH CODE.

Ordinance No. 2026-5.1 Adopted 5/11/26 AN ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW, OKLAHOMA, REGULATING DOOR-TO-DOOR COMMERCIAL SOLICITATION ACTIVITIES; ESTABLISHING PERMIT REQUIREMENTS; PROVIDING FOR TEMPORARY SIGN REGULATIONS; PROVIDING EXEMPTIONS; PROVIDING FOR ENFORCEMENT, REVOCATION, AND APPEALS; PROVIDING FOR CODIFICATION; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; REPEALING CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; AND DECLARING AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2026-3.1 Adopted 3/9/26 AN ORDINANCE AMENDING TITLE 3, CHAPTER 3 OF THE TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW CODE OF ORDINANCES BY AMENDING SECTION 3-1 (DEFINITIONS) AND BY ADDING NEW SECTIONS 3-46 THROUGH 3-50 RELATING TO THE HARBORING AND CONTROL OF CATS; PROVIDING FOR NOTICE AND OPPORTUNITY TO COMPLY; PROVIDING FOR ENFORCEMENT; REPEALING ALL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; AND DECLARING AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2025-12.2 Adopted 12/8/25 AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING BY REFERENCE CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF TITLE 47 OF THE OKLAHOMA STATUTES SO THAT THE MOUNTAIN VIEW POLICE DEPARTMENT MAY ENFORCE VIOLATIONS OF MOTOR VEHICLE AND TRAFFIC LAWS WITHIN THE TOWN LIMITS AS MUNICIPAL OFFENSES.

Ordinance No. 2025-12.1 Adopted 12/8/25 AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 3, ARTICLE 1 OF THE TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW CODE OF ORDINANCES TO UPDATE RABIES CONTROL, VACCINATION, AND QUARANTINE REQUIREMENTS IN ACCORDANCE WITH STATE LAW AND OKLAHOMA STATE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH REGULATIONS; TO CLARIFY DEFINITIONS AND PROCEDURES RELATING TO VICIOUS DOGS AND ANIMALS; REPEALING ALL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; AND PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2025-11.2 Adopted 11/10/25 AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 1-14 OF THE TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW CODE OF ORDINANCES, RELATING TO BOARD MEETINGS, AGENDA PREPARATION, AND COMPLIANCE WITH THE OKLAHOMA OPEN MEETING ACT; REPEALING ALL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; AND PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2025-7.1 Adopted 7/14/25 AN ORDINANCE AMENDING ARTICLE I, SECTION 3-14 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW, OKLAHOMA, RELATING TO INSPECTIONS TO ENFORCE CHAPTER ON ANIMALS; PROVIDING FOR REPEALER, SEVERABILITY, AND EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance of 05-12-2025(1) Adopted 5/12/25 AN ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW, OKLAHOMA, AMENDING ORDINANCE NO. 2026-6 BY CORRECTING THE WATER AND SEWER RATE STRUCTURE, ESTABLISHING SERVICE FEES, REPEALING CONFLICTING ORDINANCES, AND DECLARING AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2025-1 Adopted 4/14/25 AN ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN OF MOUNTAIN VIEW, OKLAHOMA, AMENDING ORDINANCE NO. 2023-6 BY CORRECTING THE WATER AND SEWER RATE STRUCTURE, ESTABLISHING SERVICE FEES, REPEALING CONFLICTING ORDINANCES, AND DECLARING AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
